name: Alex Rivera
headline: Partnerships and GTM lead for ecommerce platforms
summary: Partnerships lead with 8 years building agency and technology partner programs for Shopify-ecosystem companies. Sourced and closed co-sell pipeline, built partner scoring models, and ran joint events.

experience.title: Head of Partnerships
bullets: Built the agency partner program from 0 to 45 active partners, sourcing 38% of new revenue in 2024.
Designed an account-mapping model that scored 1,900 accounts against two ICPs and surfaced 210 shared-fit targets.
Ran 6 co-hosted events with technology partners, generating 120 qualified meetings.
Wrote a Python pipeline to enrich account lists with storefront technology data, replacing a manual 3-day process.

experience.title: Partner Manager
bullets: Managed 25 technology partner relationships and launched 9 integrations.
Grew partner-sourced pipeline from $1.2M to $4.5M in two years.
Created partner enablement content used by 60 partner sellers.

projects.name: Storefront theme detection tool
bullets: Open-source script that identifies the live theme on a storefront from first-party page data.
